instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium full shot. In a sunny outdoor park with a suspension bridge in the background, the woman with reddish-orange hair (R2) wearing a black off-the-shoulder crop top, grey pants, and cat-eye sunglasses dances facing forward with her hands raised to her head, smiling. Behind her on the left, the man in the striped shirt (R4) stands on the grass, clapping his hands and smiling as he watches her. Bright natural daylight illuminates the warm-toned scene, casting soft shadows.
elements: R2 dances facing forward with her hands raised to her head while R4 watches her
R4 claps his hands as he watches R2 dance
R2 is the performer and R4 is the applauding observer
